overview: Smart AI Task Manager Pro is a premium, SaaS-quality task management app with authentication, intelligent suggestions, drag-and-drop reordering, priority and tag systems, a live stats dashboard, and real-time search — all wrapped in a polished, responsive UI inspired by Notion and Linear.
features: Create, edit, and delete tasks with descriptions, due dates, priorities, and tags
Smart Suggestions — intelligent task completions as you type
Dashboard stats: Total, Completed, Pending, Overdue
Filter by All / Pending / Completed / Overdue
Internet Identity login with per-user task isolation
Color-coded priorities (Low, Medium, High) and overdue highlights
Responsive design for mobile and desktop
